Archival Dispatch: 32 Master Broadcasts Dated Across Smiley Burnette, 1960s Psychedelic Radio Promos, Golden Days of Radio, and Paul Harvey

Author: radio index

Batch 42 Forensic Discoveries

Batch 42 resolves 32 entertainment broadcasts, 1960s pop culture radio spots, golden age retrospectives, and narrative mysteries: 8 transcribed country-comedy variety episodes from The Smiley Burnette Show (1947), 8 iconic 1960s counterculture and rock 'n' roll radio commercials from Psychedelic Promos And Radio Spots (featuring The Who's Coca-Cola jingle, The Beach Boys' Murray the K promo, and The Monkees' network launch), 8 audio history episodes from Frank Bresee's The Golden Days of Radio (including Jack Webb's origin as Joe Friday on Dragnet and Martin & Lewis with Frank Sinatra), and 8 investigative narratives from Paul Harvey's The Rest of the Story (including the composition of Taps and LBJ's WWII bomber flight).
